clauses.text: Below one bagful nothing posts: the mail is never fake
One bagful posts a run, two post a second, a brimming bag posts the third — accepting drains 35

figure.note: one run at 35, two at 70, three at 100; accepting from 100 leaves 65

clauses.text: The WALK sets the tier, measured on the route the feet would take
LOCAL POST (near, safe)
LONG POST (far, or scrapper ground)
GREY POST (deep grey en route, or a dimmed/quiet destination)
Letters and dispatches take no fee — ever. Zero trust moves; the grade still stamps
The results screen has a service slip of its own: "Fee taken — NONE — Waylighters carry the mail", the read-aloud letter
Tier sets the XP and the appreciation
porter skill by tier (+14/+20/+26 Footwork, long walks add Endurance, the grey walk adds Lumenistry)

figure.note: Footwork 14, 20, 26 by tier; Endurance from a long walk; Lumenistry from the grey

clauses.text: Appreciation — each town's own ladder
KNOWN 40 · TRUSTED 100 · HONOURED 180 · BELOVED 280
a warm meal pressed into your hands when you arrive hungry
the town's children running your mailbags to the gate (letters from there weigh nothing)
Two desks per station, a third at TRUSTED

figure.record: Two desks … a third at TRUSTED
figure.note: the cap 2, then 3 at TRUSTED; the next hand turned away at each

clauses.text: the rider's dispatch — a quest, not an accrual — which swears the militia to you

when the Grey is thick a rider falls, and rides home across a saddle
It clears the CHASE, never the camp
Then they leave. Five minutes between calls
